narrative.overview: White libas and the gold-thread topi: a bright white working surface, plum-black ink, one fine gold crochet band as the only ornament, and rida colours that each carry one meaning. A working tool for office staff at a desk, shared across the FHMUM apps.
keyCharacteristics: White sheets on a faint violet-grey wash; never cream
One gold band, once per screen
Colour means something every time it appears
One typeface, Figtree, with tabular figures
Ink-filled primary buttons; gold tint marks what is selected

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Rose is Iraq, saffron is Cairo, mint is Saudi Arabia, lilac is flying. Stay options stay uncoloured.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: The gold crochet band is drawn once per screen, under the top bar.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any column of money, dates or counts uses tabular figures.

dos: Do keep the price or the count readable at a glance
Do reuse the tile band for any run of days or years
Do keep controls at 38px (44px on phones) with a visible label
donts: Don't add a second ornament, typeface or a gradient
Don't use a rida colour as decoration or for a primary button
Don't use cream, teal or the eight-point star
Don't put grey text on a tinted field
